UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Per-user account profile, RBAC role, approval status, and broker permissions for RenkoDesk.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the workstation and admin directory.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

role.description: Access control role: admin has full governance control; trader has isolated workspace access.

status.description: Workspace access status controlled by the administrator.

allowLiveMode.description: Whether this user is permitted by the admin to request Live broker mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or governance update.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's latest login.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Registry of UIDs granted administrator privileges.

grantedBy.description: UID of the administrator who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

WorkspaceConfig.title: WorkspaceConfig
WorkspaceConfig.description: Isolated per-user Renko and Supertrend configuration for a single instrument epic.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the workspace owner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest config update.

requireAdminApproval.description: When true, new users land in pending status until approved by admin.

globalAutoTradingEnabled.description: Global master switch for automated Renko execution across trader workspaces.

allowNonAdminLiveMode.description: Whether non-admin traders with allowLiveMode=true may request Live mode.

maxLotCap.description: Maximum allowed lot size cap for non-admin workspaces.

announcement.description: Optional notice banner displayed across all trader workspaces.

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who last updated governance.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest governance update.

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable administrative audit log recording user status, role, and governance actions.

actorUid.description: UID of the administrator performing the action.

actorEmail.description: Email of the administrator performing the action.

action.description: Short action code (e.g. APPROVE_USER, SUSPEND_USER, UPDATE_GOVERNANCE).

targetUid.description: Optional target user UID affected by this action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the audit event.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user profiles and RBAC state. Readable by owner or admin; listable only by admin.

/admins/{userId}.description: Administrator role registry used by security rules and UI RBAC checks.

/workspaces/{userId}/configs/{epic}.description: Isolated per-user Renko & Supertrend instrument configuration documents.

/governance/{docId}.description: Singleton global governance policy at /governance/global managed strictly by admin.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable admin audit log readable and creatable strictly by administrators.
